rationale: The assistant immediately steered away from the heater, asked the right first question about dry capacity versus wash capacity and whether heat was produced, and on learning the customer dries a full 9kg load against a 6kg dry limit correctly concluded 'hot-but-damp laundry is the expected result rather than evidence of a fault'. It never asked about spin speed, so it missed the second contributing factor (customer drops spin to 800 rpm), and the second reply repeated the cold-water tap, drain hose and pump-filter advice from the first. No fabrication, no parts, safe instructions (unplug before filter), and engineer only as a conditional last step - a sound, if slightly incomplete, resolution.
